title: Amazon's Texas AI campus to run on a 7.65-gigawatt private gas plant
summary: Permitted for up to 33.2 million tons a year if run flat-out — twice the largest US power-plant source — the off-grid Pecos County project is phased to 1 GW in 2028 and shows how AI is becoming a power-plant buildout.
